title: Suns at Jazz injury reports:
text:
Suns at Jazz injury reports: Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Suns at Jazz injury reports:
 HoopsHype Nov. 19, 2026, 7:35 p.m. ET Duane Rankin: Suns at Jazz injury reports: Suns: OUT -- Mark Williams (left shoulder surgery). Jazz: OUT -- Jonas Aidoo (G League - Two way), Harrison Ingram (G League - Two-Way), Jaren Jackson Jr. (right MCL tear), Lauri Markkanen (right hand fracture) and Jusuf Nurkic (right 2nd plantar plate tear). #Suns
